title: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Act 2023

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Act 2023
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 51
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 51
ACT VIII OF 2023
PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2023
An Act to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property
Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 17th February,
2023]
No. PAP/Legis-2(106)/2021/101, dated 17.2.2023.---The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax
(Amendment) Bill, 2021, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on the 9th day of January 2023, and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on the 23rd day of January 2023, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable
Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of 1958) for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act,
2023.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 51

ACT, 2023
An Act to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable Property
Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 17th February,
2023]
No. PAP/Legis-2(106)/2021/101, dated 17.2.2023.---The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax
(Amendment) Bill, 2021, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on the 9th day of January 2023, and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on the 23rd day of January 2023, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Punjab Urban Immovable
Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of 1958) for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 16 of Act V of 1958.---In
the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of 1958), in section 16,
in subsection (1), after clause (i), the following clause (i-a) shall be
inserted:
"(i-a) by sealing the non-residential
immovable property till the unpaid amount due against such property is paid or
recovered in full; or".
